_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. title.en: The first stretch is behind you

body.en: Twelve weeks. Many couples start telling people now. Before the news belongs to everyone, take an evening where it still belongs only to the two of you.
body.hi: बारह हफ़्ते। बहुत से जोड़े अब लोगों को बताना शुरू करते हैं। ख़बर सबकी हो जाने से पहले, एक शाम ऐसी रखिए जब यह सिर्फ़ आप दोनों की हो।
